# Definitions stay resolvable but cannot enter AD 1 gameplay.
force_change_court_language =  {
	type = diplomacy
	category = CATEGORY_INFLUENCE_ACTIONS

	potential = {
		always = no # ANTIQVITAS mounted-system quarantine
		scope:actor = {
			modifier:allow_diplomacy_force_change_court_language = yes
		}
	}

	allow = {
	}

	diplomatic_cost = force_change_court_language_cost


	ai_tick = daily
	ai_tick_frequency = 180

	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = country
		target_flag = recipient
		name = "choose_country"
		column = {
			data = name
		}
		visible = {
			is_great_power = no
			not = { court_dialect = scope:actor.court_dialect }
			NOT = { has_cooldown = force_change_court_language }
			NOT = { is_subject_of = scope:actor }
		}
        enabled = {
			trigger_if = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						has_reform = government_reform:papacy_reform
						has_reform = government_reform:kingdom_of_god_reform
					}
					court_language = language:latin_language
				}
				always = no
			}
		}
	}

	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:recipient
			}
			scope:recipient = {
				set_court_language = scope:actor.court_dialect
				add_cooldown = {
					type = force_change_court_language
					years = 10
				}
			}
		}
	}
	reject_effect = {
		reject_hegemon_ultimatum_effect = { type = country_interaction:force_change_court_language }
	}
	accept = {
		add = hegemon_demand_base_acceptance
	}
	ai_will_do = {
		#no reason not to
		add = 10
		add = hegemon_demand_base_will_do
	}
}
